title: Neocognitron — April 1980 Publication Milestone
summary: Kunihiko Fukushima's paper 'Neocognitron: A self-organizing neural network model for a mechanism of pattern recognition unaffected by shift in position' was published in Biological Cybernetics in April 1980. The paper describes a self-organizing neural-network model for visual pattern recognition, uses the name 'neocognitron', and reports position-tolerant pattern recognition after unsupervised self-organization.
significance: A primary-paper publication milestone in the history of neural-network approaches to visual pattern recognition. LINEAiGE records only the supported April 1980 publication milestone and the capabilities described in the paper; it does not convert the publication into a claim about invention date, universal priority, later influence, or direct ancestry.

verification.note: Springer Nature's publisher record identifies April 1980 as the issue/publication month, names Kunihiko Fukushima, gives the NHK Broadcasting Science Research Laboratories affiliation in Tokyo, and reproduces the abstract describing the neocognitron's self-organization and position-tolerant visual pattern recognition. No exact publication day, invention date, priority claim, ancestry, influence, causality, or relationship edge is asserted.
